name: apply_union_le
statement: FiniteMeasure Ω) {s₁ s₂ : Set Ω} : μ (s₁ ∪ s₂) ≤ μ s₁ + μ s₂

name: testAgainstNN_lipschitz_estimate
statement: FiniteMeasure Ω) (f g : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) : μ.testAgainstNN f ≤ μ.testAgainstNN g + nndist f g * μ.mass

have_tree.name: le_dist
have_tree.type: ∀ ω, dist (f ω) (g ω) ≤ nndist f g

have_tree.name: le'
have_tree.type: f ω ≤ g ω + nndist f g

name: tendsto_zero_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_zero_mass
statement: Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} (mass_lim : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).mass) F (𝓝 0)) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).testAgainstNN f) F (𝓝 0)

name: injective_toWeakDualBCNN
statement: Injective (toWeakDualBCNN : FiniteMeasure Ω → WeakDual ℝ≥0 (Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0))

name: tendsto_of_forall_integral_tendsto
statement: Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} (h : ∀ f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ, Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)) F (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure Ω)))) : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ)

name: tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto
statement: Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ) ↔ ∀ f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ, Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)) F (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure Ω)))

name: map_apply_of_aemeasurable
statement: FiniteMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν) {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) : ν.map f A = ν (f ⁻¹' A)
